remarks: Modern Manhattan loft-style living meets intimate, exclusive sophistication in the heart of Mid-City Stamford! Step inside to soaring 10-11ft ceilings, sweeping views & southwestern exposures in this light-filled, 2 bedroom, 2 full bath condo w/separate den (perfect for private home office or guests). Gourmet kitchen w/high-end stainless steel appliances (Wolf/Sub-Zero/Asko), oak cabinetry w/ample storage, granite countertops & breakfast bar enhanced w/subway tile backsplash & pendant lighting. Expansive living room & dining area w/gorgeous tree-topped views as the focal point from the wall of ceiling-height picture windows. Primary BR immersed in natural light from ceiling-height windows featuring spacious walk-in closet, 2nd closet & full bath w/double-sink vanity. Sunlit 2nd BR w/wall of ceiling-height windows, walk-in closet & easy access to large hall bath w/jetted tub. Hardwood floors throughout, full-size washer & dryer & smart lights & thermostat. Hot water, heat delivery & gas cooking included. Additional amenities: 2 deeded garage parking spaces, concierge, private residents' club & fitness rooms, package room, private wine storage, double-elevators, plenty of visitor parking, secured building access & pets welcome! Just steps to all - shops, restaurants, parks, houses of worship & conveniences. Just over 1 mile to Stamford RR & I-95! An extraordinary, limited-edition, in-town living experience awaits you! Come let the sunshine in at the Metropolitan today!
